Print method for a summary.noise_spec object

Source: R/noise_spec.R
print.summary.noise_spec.Rd

Formats the sample-diagnostic summary of a noise_spec object as a compact report: distributional parameters, sample mean and variance, lag-one autocorrelation and empirical spectral slope.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'summary.noise_spec'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A summary.noise_spec object.

...

Unused.

Value

The input x, invisibly.

See also

summary.noise_spec() . summary constructor.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
print(summary(colored_noise(beta = 1)))
} # }
